description.zh: 频道名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
description.en: The channel name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: \[A-Za-z0-9\_-]+
The channel description. It can be up to 1,000 characters in length.

description.zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
description.en: The channel group name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: \[A-Za-z0-9\_-]+
The ingest protocol. Only HLS is supported.
The number of M3U8 segments. Valid values: 2 to 100.
The segment duration. Valid values: 1 to 30.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明

通过此API，您可以修改实时打包服务中指定频道的配置信息。需要提供频道所在的频道组名称、频道名称，以及要更新的协议类型、分段时长和分段数量。此外，您还可以选择性地添加或修改频道的描述信息。请确保提供的频道组名称与频道名称符合规范要求。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

You need to provide the name of the channel group to which the channel belongs, channel name, protocol, segment duration, and number of segments to update. In addition, you can choose to add or modify the description of the channel. Make sure that the provided channel group name and channel name conform to the naming conventions.
